name: IdFM Train Pack
description:
This pack contains various material for Paris; some in current use, some very soon. You will find:
Metro on Rail (MF 01/MF 19), Metro on rubber tyres (MP 89/MP 14), Metro for the Grand Paris Express (MR3V/MR6V)
Trains for the RER (MI 09/MI 84/MI 20/Z 2N/RER NG)
Trains for the Transilien (NAT/Francilien)
Tram-trains for the Express lines (Dualis)
Trams for the surrounding suburbs of Paris (Citadis)
APM for Orly and Roissy Airport (VAL)
